metadata.title: John Doe | Full-Stack Developer

hero.title: Full-Stack Developer
hero.tagline: Building modern web applications with clean code and thoughtful design

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me
about.introduction: I'm a passionate full-stack developer with over 5 years of experience building web applications. I enjoy turning complex problems into simple, beautiful, and intuitive solutions.

whatIDo.title: What I Do
whatIDo.description: I specialize in building modern web applications using React, Next.js, Laravel, and other cutting-edge technologies. From frontend interfaces to backend APIs, I deliver complete solutions that scale.

lookingFor.title: What I'm Looking For
lookingFor.description: I'm seeking opportunities to work on challenging projects with teams that value code quality, collaboration, and continuous learning. Remote-friendly positions in Japan or worldwide.

ecommerce.title: E-Commerce Platform
ecommerce.description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with product management, shopping cart, and Stripe payment integration.

taskmanager.title: Task Management App
taskmanager.description: A collaborative task management application with real-time updates, team workspaces, and analytics dashboard.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website
portfolio.description: A bilingual portfolio website built with Next.js 16, featuring modern design and smooth animations.

api.title: RESTful API Service
api.description: A scalable RESTful API built with Laravel, featuring authentication, rate limiting, and comprehensive documentation.
